items.title: Commencement
notes:
A special meeting of City Council was held at 9:21 a.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof - NIL
House of Friendship - Funding Agreement, CSD-2022-480
notes: Council considered Community Services Department report CSD-2022-480 dated November 14, 2022, recommending approval of funding of $158,621 for the services provided by House of Friendship be moved from the Tier 1 grant program and placed into the Neighbourhood Programs and services operating budget.

items.title: Being a by-law to authorize borrowing for current expenditures in 2023.
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council on January 9, 2023.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 9:25 a.m.

motions.item_title: House of Friendship - Funding Agreement, CSD-2022-480
motions.text: "That funding of $158,621 for the services provided by House of Friendship be moved from the Tier 1 grant program and placed into the Neighbourhood Programs and services operating budget, as outlined in Community Services Department report CSD-2022-480; and further, That the General Manager, Community Services be authorized to execute a Funding Agreement, subject to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor, every two years with House of Friendship to cover expenses associated with providing food programs at City of Kitchener facilities."
